product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides cloud-network security and workload-containment software that lets enterprises control and secure workload communications across cloud environments.
product_one_liner.notes: Based on Aviatrix’s current homepage and platform description.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing, including $12 per covered workload/month for Outbound Containment and $6 for Lateral Containment after the stated free period.

named_customers.notes: All three appear on the company’s customer page.

employee_band.notes: Aviatrix’s LinkedIn company profile reports a 201–500 employee size band.

hq_location.notes: The current LinkedIn company profile identifies Santa Clara as headquarters, and Aviatrix’s contact page lists its office there. A 2022 article reported a relocation to Dallas, so older sources may differ.

founded_year.notes: Aviatrix’s October 2024 anniversary article says its founder launched the company in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: At least two posts explain product architecture: a data-plane technical deep dive by a Technical Marketing Engineer and a Kubernetes Firewall architecture post by Aviatrix’s CTO/SVP of Engineering.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site has extensive product guides, reference material, release information, and troubleshooting content.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job listing snapshot showed eight roles, including engineering and sales roles, but no role title matching the specified AI, ML, or data-science categories.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public documentation, trust/security content, privacy/legal links, and relevant blog material; no source identified a model provider used by Aviatrix’s product.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR. GDPR is listed there, though it is generally a regulation rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Sources identify a latest funding entry dated December 8, 2022, described as an undisclosed venture round, but do not give its amount or a definitive stage. The most recent disclosed round was $200 million Series E in September 2021; amount_usd 0 is only a placeholder for undisclosed data, not a claim that the round was zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding history identifies the latest funding entry as December 2022, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026; the last publicly announced round was Series E in September 2021.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current listing includes a Senior Inside Sales Representative role, which is a sales-representative title.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix announced the launch of Aviatrix Clearance on October 26, 2026, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership roster and corporate newsroom show no C-level or VP-level join or departure during November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The dated executive appointments found were earlier than the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Director of Marketing Operations posting names these as examples of marketing technologies. It is a technology-stack signal, not confirmation that each system is currently deployed.
